title: Analog Days: No Internet Access
description: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM · On Monday and Tuesday, August 3rd and 4th , the Marmot library system will undergo a planned server upgrade. During this time, some of our library services will be temporarily unavailable while important system maintenance is completed. The following services will be unavailable: Internet access at the library Sierra (staff circulation system) The online library catalog Public printing Libby (unless you are already logged in) Online databases New York Times access Libby Users If you use Libby for ebooks or audiobooks, please log in before Monday, August 3rd . If you are already signed in, you'll be able to continue reading and listening during the outage. However, you will not be able to log in, create a new account, or borrow new titles while the system is offline. We also recommend downloading any books you'd like to enjoy during the outage in advance. …

title: Musik 4 Kinders
description: 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM · Music, Movement, and Joyful Learning for Kids! This program will be in the program room. ¡Música, Movimiento, y Aprendizaje Alegre para niños! Este programa será en la sala de programas.

title: CANCELLED: Strings in the Stacks: Live Violin with Annie Foxen
description: 12:00 PM – 1:00 PM · Unwind at the library with live violin music from violinist and WPL staff member, Annie Foxen. On the first Monday of every month, Annie fills the library with a calming mix of classical, Celtic, and folk tunes—perfect for reading, relaxing, or simply listening. Free and open to the public. All ages are welcome.

title: Ping Pong
description: A free drop-in ping pong event at the Wilkinson Public Library's Program Room, open to the community with bilingual welcome in both English and Spanish. Bring your competitive spirit and enjoy a casual afternoon of table tennis.

title: Savvy Seniors-Puzzle and Pie
description: 1:30 PM – 2:30 PM · Join us every Monday for "Savvy Seniors," an exciting and interactive class designed for senior citizens who are curious about the world around them! This unique program goes beyond basic tech lessons to explore a wide range of engaging topics, including science, technology, environmental awareness, art, and music. Each session features a guest expert who will guide participants through fun, hands-on activities—from planting your own herbs to creating art, experimenting with science, and even exploring the therapeutic power of music. Whether you're looking to enhance your tech skills, discover new hobbies, or simply enjoy stimulating conversations with peers, this class has something for everyone. This Monday we will be putting together a puzzle together and having some pie.

title: Hobby Hopping: Pickleball
description: 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM · Learn a new hobby every Monday afternoon in the summer! August 3: Pickle Ball August 10: Cyanotype Printing August 17: Bullet Journaling August 31: Music Production: DJ TJ Highland

title: Puzzle Competition
description: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM · Space is limited to 10 teams of two, so make sure to sign up today! NEW, PLEASE NOTE: Only one team member needs to sign up for their team of two. Dive into the ultimate puzzle challenge at Wilkinson Public Library's Puzzle Competition! Join us on Monday, August 3rd, from 5 to 7pm for an evening of brain-teasing fun. Gather your partner and prepare to piece together a 500-piece puzzle against the clock. It's a race to the finish as teams compete head-to-head to claim the title of puzzle champions! All participants will work on the same puzzle, ensuring a level playing field for everyone. This event isn't just about speed—it's about camaraderie and community. Puzzle enthusiasts of all ages are invited to showcase their skills and enjoy an evening of friendly competition. …
